title: Design Pattern
description: A reusable governance or engineering approach for implementing a decision — the 'how' that connects a governance decision to concrete practice, analogous to a pattern catalog entry.

problem.description: The governance problem this pattern addresses.

solution.description: The pattern's approach to solving the problem.

applicability.description: When and where this pattern should be applied.

consequences.description: Trade-offs, costs, or limitations of adopting this pattern.

maturity.description: How widely proven this pattern is in practice.
